mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as mrCName, c1.C_Abbreviation as mrAbbName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, met.Met_Name as metName, mn.*, dep.D_Name as mrReportDepartmentName,cd.Construction_Drawing_Code as mrConstructionDrawingCode from Maintenance_Record mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_Department dep on mn.Mr_Report_Department_Id = dep.D_Id left join construction_drawing cd on cd.id=mn.Mr_Report_Construction_Drawing_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Mr_C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Mr_Id left join Me_Type_Library met on met.Met_Id=mn.Met_Id where mn.Mr_Id=#{mrId}

sql.if: and exists (select 1 from maintenance_finance mf where mf.mr_id=mn.mr_id and mf.mf_code like concat('%',#{params.mfCode},'%'))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sporadic_settlement_dtl ssd JOIN sporadic_settlement ss ON ss.id = ssd.se_id WHERE ssd.mr_id = mn.mr_id AND ss.state != 3)
and exists ( select 1 from maintenance_finance mf2 where mf2.mr_id = mn.mr_id and mf2.mf_code like CONCAT('%', #{params.jinfeihao}, '%') )

mapper.select:
select
con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, c1.C_Name_History as mrCNameHistory, c1.C_Name as mrCName, c1.C_Abbreviation as mrAbbName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, met.Met_Name as metName, mn.*,
pro.p_name as pName, mc.id as mc_id, mc.create_uid as mc_create_uid, mc.create_uname as mc_create_uname, mc.create_time as mc_create_time, mc.state as mc_state, mc.state_time as mc_state_time, mc.m_content as m_content, mc.m_picture as m_picture, mc.start_time as start_time, mc.end_time as end_time, mc.end_picture as end_picture, mc.mr_id as mc_mr_id, mf.id as mf_id, mf.create_uid as mf_create_uid, mf.create_uname as mf_create_uname, mf.create_time as mf_create_time, mf.state as mf_state, mf.state_time as mf_state_time, mf.mf_source as mf_source, mf.mf_code as mf_code, mf.mr_id as mf_mr_id, mf.mf_budget as mf_budget from Maintenance_Record mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id
left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Mr_C_Id left join Sys_Department dep on mn.Mr_Report_Department_Id = dep.D_Id left join Me_Type_Library met on met.Met_Id=mn.Met_Id left join maintenance_finance mf on mf.mr_id=mn.mr_id left join maintenance_content mc on mc.mr_id=mn.mr_id
${params.authSql}
((select count(*) from SYS_FlowActivity fa left join sys_task_processin tp on tp.tp_actid=fa.actid left join sys_user u1 on u1.u_id=tp.tp_user where tp_entityid=mn.mr_id and actcode='construction' and u1.c_id=#{params.ggCid}) > 0 or (select count(*) from sys_task tk where tk.taskentityid=mn.mr_id and taskuser=#{params.ggUid})>0 or (select count(*) from sys_task_processin tp where tp.tp_entityid=mn.mr_id and tp_user=#{params.ggUid})>0 )
where 1=1
AND ( mn.mr_Create_Uid = #{params.ggUid} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_task_processin WHERE tp_entityid = mn.mr_id AND tp_user = #{params.ggUid} ) )
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Mr_Create_Time desc
mapper.sql: (SELECT Jinfeihao FROM ( SELECT LISTAGG(t.mf_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.mf_code) AS Jinfeihao FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT mf2.mf_code FROM maintenance_finance mf2 WHERE mf2.mr_id = '1' ) t )) Jinfeihao,
(select GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mf2.mf_code ORDER BY mf2.mf_code SEPARATOR ',') from maintenance_finance mf2 where mf2.mr_id = mn.mr_id) as Jinfeihao,
mapper.select: select * from sys_task where TaskEntityID = #{mrId} order by TaskSendTime desc limit 1
select * from sys_task_processin where tp_entityid = #{mrId} order by tp_dotime desc limit 1

select mn.* ,dep.D_Name as mrReportDepartmentName ,cd.Construction_Drawing_Code as mrReportConstructionDrawingCode ,c1.C_Name as mrCName ,u1.U_Name as mrRepairUname ,u2.U_Name as mrDispatchUname,u3.U_Name as mrCreateUname, cd.construction_Drawing_Name as mrConstructionDrawingName, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId from Maintenance_Record mn left join sys_department dep on mn.Mr_Report_Department_Id = dep.D_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Mr_C_Id left join sys_user u1 on u1.U_ID=mn.Mr_Repair_Uid left join sys_user u2 on u2.U_ID=mn.Mr_Dispatch_Uid left join sys_user u3 on u3.U_ID=mn.Mr_Create_Uid left join construction_drawing cd on cd.id=mn.Mr_Report_Construction_Drawing_Id left join Sys_File sf on sf.FileID=mn.Mr_Id where mn.Mr_Id=#{mrId}
mapper.update: UPDATE maintenance_record mr LEFT JOIN construction_completion_confirm ccc ON mr.mr_id = ccc.mr_id LEFT JOIN inv_settlement_apply_dtl isad ON mr.mr_id = isad.mr_id LEFT JOIN inv_settlement_apply isa ON isad.isa_id = isa.sa_id LEFT JOIN inv_settlement_pay isp ON isa.sa_id = isp.inv_Settlement_Apply_Id LEFT JOIN application_warranty aw ON isp.id = aw.isp_id SET mr.mr_repair_state = CASE WHEN mr.mr_repair_state = '03' AND ccc.state = 3 THEN '02' WHEN mr.mr_repair_state = '05' AND isa.sa_state = 3 THEN '04' WHEN mr.mr_repair_state = '07' AND isp.state = 3 THEN '06' WHEN mr.mr_repair_state = '09' AND aw.state = 3 THEN '08' ELSE mr.mr_repair_state END WHERE mr.mr_repair_state IN ('03', '05', '07', '09') AND ( (mr.mr_repair_state = '03' AND ccc.state = 3) OR (mr.mr_repair_state = '05' AND isa.sa_state = 3) OR (mr.mr_repair_state = '07' AND isp.state = 3) OR (mr.mr_repair_state = '09' AND aw.state = 3) )
mapper.select: select mn.*, aw.state as awState from maintenance_record mn left join inv_settlement_apply_dtl sad on sad.Mr_Id = mn.Mr_Id left join inv_settlement_apply sa on sa.Sa_Id = sad.Isa_Id left join Inv_Settlement_Pay isp on isp.inv_settlement_apply_id = sa.Sa_Id left join Application_Warranty aw on aw.isp_Id = isp.id where aw.id = #{id}

select stp.tp_user from sys_task_processin stp left join sys_flowactivity act on act.actId=stp.tp_actid where stp.tp_entityid = #{mrId} and act.actcode = #{actCode} order by stp.tp_dotime desc limit 1
